note: Needs-first life coverage (v4). Eight human needs are the primary discovery layer. Presentation map v1 resolves them through 18 plain categories and 39 plain subcategories. Every live and growing source row maps exactly once while the complete v3 domain -> group -> category -> optional facet tree remains intact as a compatibility index. A source row with a 'cid' is live; one without is shown as 'Not yet covered'. Group labels are noun phrases drawn from content/taxonomy.json, the full map. See docs/design/INFORMATION-ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/TAXONOMY.md.

presentation.purpose: The public needs-first path. Selectors resolve the preserved domain rows into one category and one subcategory without duplicating the source leaves.

leafState.gapIdRule: Kebab-case the source-row label; fail the build if two gap labels produce the same id.

presentation.selectorRule: A source row matches when its need equals the category need and it matches one selector. Domain is required; groups and labels narrow a selector when present. Every source row must match exactly once.
